commitments.title: 3 non-negotiable commitments.

items.d: You issue your invoice and get paid within 7 days of receipt. No waiting for month-end or 60–90 day terms: real liquidity so your cash flow can breathe and you compete without financing the work yourself.

items.t: The best price on equipment and parts — plus warranties that add up
items.d: New equipment at the network's best price when a repair isn't worth it, OEM parts with a 40%–70% discount off list price, and extended warranties you offer for a commission. More margin per job and new recurring revenue.

Business, health, life and legal-protection cover negotiated as a block, directly with leading insurers, on terms you couldn't get on your own as a sole trader or small business. So you can work with peace of mind, fully protected.

commitments.outro: The rest we'll build together, at your pace and to your needs.
